text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One afternoon, on my day off, I hear a familiar voice in the shopping mall.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All right, Creek, you ready to roll?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I certainly am, Tamtam! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, well if it isn't my trainer! You joinin' in on the tussle?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ya haven't heard? The mall's havin' a big blowout sale today!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm here for Violet. ♪ They're a really nice brand for ladies' fashion.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tamtam really is a veteran bargain hunter, so I'm tagging along for some clothes shopping.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yep, just stick with the expert! Don't go strayin' off either, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yep, now let's roll out!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That was a real skirmish, I tell ya… Definitely tossed you two into the deep end.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But check out all the spoils! We made out like bandits!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You grabbed this many Violet clothes? Oh! This is the item I said I wanted…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Heh! A senior's gotta look out for her juniors.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tamtam, you're amazing! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But everything here is in my size… I'd like you to try on some Violet clothes too, Tamtam!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh?! N-nope, I'm good. Frills aren't really my style, y'know what I mean?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-where's this comin' from?! C'mon, you know this stuff wouldn't suit me!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ Well, why not have a little faith in your trainer and try it on?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Lemme goooo! Just how strong are you?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A little later…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, I just knew it! ♪ You look wonderful, Tamtam.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's huge on me! I look like a preschooler wearin' your blouse like a dress!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the blink of an eye, Tamamo Cross disappears to get changed.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa! An oversized hoodie with a lightnin' bolt pattern on it! You sure got an eye for fashion!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah. I'm way better off wearin' cool clothes like this.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's my trainer! I know I can count on you to know exactly what I like!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Aww, that's a shame… but the hoodie looks just as lovely. ♪ The design really brings out your sporty side.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tamtam, why don't you get changed right away?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Gotta show off my style!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross and Super Creek head happily toward the changing rooms.
